caption: The drawing depicts a rectangular wooden frame bed with vertical wooden spindles evenly spaced along the sides, enclosed on all four sides. Inside the bed, there is a human figure with a beard and dark hair, shown lying flat on their back. The figure's skin has a yellowish tone, with red and blue markings at various points on the body, particularly on the feet, knees, side, and hands, representing wounds. The figure is draped with a white cloth around the waist, leaving the chest and legs exposed, and the anatomical details are carefully rendered with visible ribs and muscle structure. Underneath the figure, there is a pink mattress featuring a white floral pattern, with a white pillow placed under the head. A dark cloth appears to be tied around the figure’s head and chin. The bed and the figure occupy most of the space, with a white border surrounding the drawing. In the bottom left corner of the image, there is a block of handwritten text, which includes phrases such as “Penitente Santo Enterio,” “Adorno 'CHRIST' - 5'1",” and a date, “June 21, 1937.”
title: Penitente Santo Entierro or (Saint in Earth)
